t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Good information that I didn't notice during the practice run

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes are split into 2 colour groups that holds a yellow and red basket. The closest colour related to either red of yellow will determine the outcome the the basket they give. For example, between green and purple, the colour green is closely relate to yellow and purple is closely related to red basket. Same goes for orange for yellow and brown for the red basket. Reaction time might also determine how much bonus mushrooms you'll receive. If the reward for a specific coloured basket becomes low, change your basket of choice to get higher mushroom reward. The reward will dynamically change and you will have to adjust your basket colour if you noticed that the value is going down.
